inputs.src/pkg/_cli_argparse.py:
import argparse


def build():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="argtool", description="d")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", "-v", action="store_true", help="Verbose output")
    parser.add_argument("path")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")
    run = sub.add_parser("run", help="Run it")
    run.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=3, required=False)
    group = run.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    group.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true")
    nested = run.add_subparsers()
    deep = nested.add_parser("deep")
    deep.add_argument("--level", "-l")
    return parser

import argparse
from argparse import ArgumentParser

NAME = "dyn"


def build(parser_arg):
    parser = ArgumentParser(prog="diag")
    parser.add_argument(NAME)
    parser.add_argument(f"--{NAME}")
    for item in ("a", "b"):
        parser.add_argument("--loop")
    parser_arg.add_argument("--unbound")
    child = ArgumentParser(prog="child", parents=[parser])
    child.add_argument("--own")
    return parser
